subcategory_text: Establish, implement, and actively manage (track, report, correct) the security configuration of network infrastructure devices using a rigorous configuration management and change-control process.
implementation_examples: IG1: Document network topology; segment per function
IG2: Centralise network configuration; monitor changes
IG3: Use intent-based networking; automated compliance
assessment_objectives: Determine whether network configurations are managed.
Determine whether the topology is segmented.
